body:
## Goal
Serve the sign-in-gated JSON REST API for accounts, projects, and tasks, enqueue export jobs without producing the report, and apply pending migrations on boot.

## Spec
Built on Node's built-in HTTP server — no external web framework. Listens on the PORT env var, default 3000. On boot it applies any pending store migrations (via the store unit's programmatic entry) so a fresh checkout works straight away.

Auth: POST /auth/register with JSON {username, password} creates a user and responds with {id, username}. POST /auth/login with the same body responds {token} — a bearer token the client sends as `Authorization` on every other request. Passwords are hashed with the platform crypto (e.g. node:crypto scrypt/pbkdf2) — plaintext passwords are never stored or logged (security invariant, inviolable). A deactivated account (active flag false, set by the admin CLI) cannot log in — login is rejected with 401. Every non-auth route requires a valid bearer token; missing or invalid -> 401.

Projects (owner-scoped): POST /projects {name} -> the created project {id, name, ownerId, createdAt}. GET /projects -> a JSON array of only the caller's own projects. GET /projects/:id and DELETE /projects/:id operate only on the caller's own projects; a project owned by someone else or an unknown id -> 404 (do not leak existence across users). Deleting a project also removes its tasks.

Tasks (scoped within a project the caller owns): POST /projects/:projectId/tasks {title} -> the created task {id, title, projectId, createdAt, done:false}. GET /projects/:projectId/tasks is paginated as {items, total, page, pageSize} driven by ?page and ?pageSize (sensible defaults), with an optional ?done=true|false filter. PATCH /projects/:projectId/tasks/:taskId {title?, done?} -> the updated task. DELETE /projects/:projectId/tasks/:taskId removes it. Tasks under a project the caller does not own -> 404.

Exports (enqueue only): POST /projects/:projectId/exports responds immediately with a job record {id, status} and WITHOUT the report — the report MUST NOT be produced inside the request handler (that is the worker's job). GET /projects/:projectId/exports/:exportId returns the job; while pending it carries no report, and the polling contract (status becomes "completed" carrying {report:{name,total,done}}) is fulfilled by the worker unit.

Robustness: malformed JSON, missing required fields, or wrong types -> 400 with a JSON error; the server never crashes on a bad request.

## Acceptance
- [ ] AC-1: POST /auth/register {username,password} responds with the new user's {id, username}; the stored credential is a hash, not the plaintext password
- [ ] AC-2: POST /auth/login returns {token}; a request to any project/task/export route without a valid bearer token is rejected with 401
- [ ] AC-3: A user deactivated in the store (active=false) is rejected at POST /auth/login with 401
- [ ] AC-4: POST /projects {name} returns {id, name, ownerId, createdAt}; GET /projects returns a JSON array containing only the caller's own projects
- [ ] AC-5: GET /projects/:id and DELETE /projects/:id on a project owned by another user return 404; deleting a project also removes that project's tasks
- [ ] AC-6: POST /projects/:projectId/tasks {title} returns {id, title, projectId, createdAt, done:false}
- [ ] AC-7: GET /projects/:projectId/tasks returns {items, total, page, pageSize} honoring ?page and ?pageSize, and ?done=true|false filters the items
- [ ] AC-8: PATCH /projects/:projectId/tasks/:taskId with {title} and/or {done} returns the updated task; DELETE removes it
- [ ] AC-9: POST /projects/:projectId/exports responds immediately with {id, status} and NO report field — the report is not computed in the handler
- [ ] AC-10: GET /projects/:projectId/exports/:exportId returns the job record for a pending job with no report present
- [ ] AC-11: A malformed JSON body or a request missing required fields yields a 400 and the server process stays up (does not crash)

## Verify
- node --test test/api.auth.test.js (contract)
- node --test test/api.projects.test.js (contract)
- node --test test/api.tasks.test.js (contract)
- node --test test/api.exports.test.js (contract)
- npm run typecheck (validate)

## Non-Goals
- Producing the export report (the worker unit) — the handler only enqueues
- The `npm start` combined bootstrap and the worker loop (the worker/runtime unit)
- Defining or migrating schema (the store unit owns it)
